headline: Public hearing on a temporary moratorium on data center use, plus review of 179 apartments and retail space at 37 Enon Street.
summary: Public hearings cover a proposed temporary moratorium on data center use and a plan to demolish a supermarket at 37 Enon Street and build 179 apartments. A hearing on dividing 38 Standley Street into four single-family house lots will be scheduled.
items: Public hearing on City Council Order #250-2026, proposed amendments to the City of Beverly Zoning Ordinance to institute a temporary moratorium on data center use

Site Plan Review #171-26, Special Permit #207-26, and Inclusionary Housing Application #31-26 for 37 Enon Street (Beverly Tre LLC c/o Alexander & Femino): demolish the existing supermarket and build a new building with 179 residential apartments, 60% one-bedroom and 40% two-bedroom, with 22 apartments (12%) affordable to households at or below 60% of area median income, about 2,600 square feet of retail space, and a special permit for 281 parking spaces where the ordinance requires 367

Set date for future public hearing on Open Space Residential Design (OSRD) Site Plan Review Application #13-25 for 38 Standley Street (Waring School Inc., Timothy Bakland, Head of School): divide the 4.38 acre parcel, demolish the current residence, and construct four new single-family residences, each with its own driveway off Standley Street, consistent with the Preferred Plan chosen in April 2025
location: City of Beverly Middle School Library, 502 Cabot Street, Beverly, MA 01915

**Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at 7:00 pm**

Pursuant to Chapter 2 of the Acts of 2023, Section 40, adopted on March 29, 2023, this meeting of the City of Beverly Planning Board will be conducted in-person and via remote participation. For this meeting, members of the public who wish to attend via remote participation may do so through the Google Meet information provided at the end of the agenda.

- Call to Order
  1. Subdivision Approval Not Required Plans
  2. Recess for Public Hearings
     a. Public Hearing on City Council Order #250-2026 – Proposed Amendments to the City of Beverly Zoning Ordinance – Institute a Temporary Moratorium on Data Center Use
     b. Site Plan Review #171-26, Special Permit #207-26, and Inclusionary Housing Application #31-26 – 37 Enon Street – Beverly Tre LLC c/o Alexander & Femino, One School Street, Beverly, MA 01915
        i. Applicant will demolish the existing supermarket at the property and construct a new building containing 179 residential apartments. 60% of the new apartments will be one-bedroom apartments and 40% will be two-bedroom apartments. Twenty-two (22), or 12%, of the new apartments will be affordable to households with income at or below 60% of the area median income (AMI) that applies to subsidized housing in the City of Beverly, as reported annually by the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) adjusted for household size. The new building will also contain approximately 2,600 square feet of retail space. The Applicant is seeking a Special Permit from Sections 300-59D and 300-59E of the City of Beverly Zoning Ordinance to allow 281 parking spaces where the Zoning Ordinance requires 367 parking spaces.
  3. Reconvene Meeting
  4. Set Date for Future Public Hearings
     a. Open Space Residential Design (OSRD) Site Plan Review Application #13-25 – 38 Standley Street – Waring School Inc. (Timothy Bakland, Head of School)
        i. Application for the division of the 4.38 acre parcel of land at 38 Standley Street which includes the demolition of the current residence on the property and constructing four new single-family residences each with individual driveway access off of Standley Street consistent with the Preferred Plan chosen by the Planning Board in April, 2025.
  5. Approval of Minutes (as available):
     a. October 6, 2026
- Adjournment
